name: BIRCON Berlin
blurb: A two-day pen-and-paper tabletop roleplaying convention in Berlin with games, vendors, panels and an afterparty at the Vollgutlager.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'BIRCON 2026 ... October 10th–11th, Vollgutlager' and 'When Saturday, 10th October and Sunday, 11th October, 2026 ... Where Vollgutlager, Neukölln, Berlin'.

notes: Seed types said 'pop' but the whole site is a pen-and-paper RPG event (systems list: Daggerheart, Call of Cthulhu, Shadowdark, D&D, Pathfinder, etc.), corrected to 'tabletop'. No individual guest program; the only named outside party is Gold Sponsor Chaosium (a publisher, not a person), so guests is 'none'.
